background: Credit Mutuel is a French mutual banking group owned by its members through regional federations, funded by retail deposits and lending to households, farmers and small businesses, with insurance and the CIC network alongside.
synthesis: Two of the three main agencies rate the group, A+ on average and both on a stable outlook, with no rating action in the last 90 days. Capital is among the strongest of EU and Nordic banks, with CET1 of 20.5% and leverage of 8.0% both in the top quarter, and both have risen since 30 Sep 2024, by 1.8 and 0.9 points. Liquidity is mixed, LCR of 170% above the median but NSFR of 116% below it. The figures run only to 31 Dec 2025, so they are older than most peers'.
